name: Splash Alive — the living island menu with the five-bite ladder
thesis: Borrow Hole.io's measured skeleton exactly (violet ground #4c3cbe over 45% of the frame, a diorama of the CURRENT level at 49% of frame height, five colour-coded pips, one full-width PLAY, three hue-coded tabs, one tap to playing — recon.md:25-30, :370-381) and improve every borrowed part with something Hole.io cannot do. (1) Their diorama is a dead model; ours is the ALREADY-RUNNING world (createIsland top-level await :1733, animate() renders unconditionally :10948-10957) with a crowd that has jobs (life.update :10281), moving water on Pirate (island.ts:3880-3931), the waterfall and balloon on Maple (island.ts:3812-3838, :8857), star twinkle (island.ts:801-834) and real shadows — so the splash image is literally alive at zero added render cost. (2) Their hole is a hole; ours is a creature with a face who sits in the foreground of the diorama, blinks, breathes, follows your finger and chomps when tapped (void3d.ts:2050, :2297-2310, :2340-2347; setMood/pinMouth/chomp API void3d.ts:54-75). (3) Their pips are numbers; ours speak the goal in the world's own voice (COPY.heroCue voice :1543-1664) on a goal line under the pips, and the diorama's camera nudges toward the level's subject. (4) Their three tabs are store/home/skins; ours are SHOP / HOME / SCRAPBOOK, and the scrapbook is a book with chapters (stickers, trophies, top voids) — collection instead of cosmetics. (5) Their season is nothing; ours is a season chip in the status strip that lights the diorama's world lantern (seasons.ts EVENTS + ribbon :6778-6796). (6) Their end card is a bar; ours lights the bitten pip first, then counts coins, then shows the next reward as the next world's locked island poster (paintWorldCard :6689 + .locked filter index.html:1416). The daily quest board is retired (owner decision, polish-plan.md:168) and its questEvent signal (:4018) is kept as the SET counter's feed. Nothing is a hole, nothing is an ad, nothing on the menu ticks.

hero_diorama:
WHAT IS RENDERED: the one scene that is already built and already drawn every frame behind the opaque menu (island :1733, render :10948-10957) — no second renderer, no second island. The camera frames the level's subject: the world's hero landmark (COPY.hero for five worlds :1558-1653; Maple has hero:null :1501 so the Town Hall at 3D (42.75,-68) island.ts:8065 is authored as its menu subject) in the upper two-thirds of the window and THE VOID in the lower-left third, in the foreground, facing the camera. At menu entry the void is warped to a parking spot 9 units in front of the hero on the camera side (the __warpVoid snap pattern :2262-2270; beginMatch re-places him at spawn — verify at :6081-6161), mood 'cruise' via voidling.setMood (rig API, not _dbg; void3d.ts:54), pupils track the pointer over the window (lookX/lookY void3d.ts:2340-2347), a tap on the void plays chomp(k) + 'smug' for 1.2 s then back to 'cruise'; pressing PLAY sets 'hungry' for the descent.
CAMERA: a fourth branch beside ASSETVIEW/TOPDOWN at :10488-10494 (`else if (onMenu)`), writing camera.position/lookAt directly, never camOffset/camDist/camFollow/targetDist; target = the point one third of the way from the void to the hero; distance 22 units, height 9 units, look-at 2 units above ground. A local `menuDist = 22` is fed to updateLodBias/fitShadow (:10894-10895), crowdGate (:10277 → 22*2.2+90 = 138 units of full-rate crowd) and fog (:10647). Close framing keeps the frame in the ~1,241-draw-call class, not the 4,694 intro-height class (:10496-10500). Per level the camera nudges: L1/L2/L5 the default; L3 LANDMARK the target slides 30% toward the hero (the child sees what she must eat); L4 RIVALS the family stands 6 units behind the void (rivals frozen, visible).
MOTION BUDGET: camera pendulum yaw ±6° around the target over a 16 s period (peak 0.04°/frame) → measured as median 0.6 px/frame at the hero silhouette, never >1.5 px/frame (recon.md:629 '~0.3 px/frame' spirit: the world moves, the UI does not); the void's blink (0.16 s every 2.5 s + pattern) and breath ±1.6% at 2.2 rad/s (void3d.ts:2050, :2297-2310) — untouched; the world's own free idles: Maple waterfall scroll 1.6 uv/s + spray pulse + balloon (island.ts:4019-4025), Pirate bay swell shader (island.ts:3880-3931), crowd with jobs inside 138 units (life.ts:6808-6866), curios spin (:9487), star twinkle (island.ts:801-834). UI motion: zero px/frame, with two DECLARED exceptions: PLAY breathes scale 1.00→1.03 on a 1.6 s period and the current pip's white ring pulses opacity 0.7→1.0 on a 1.2 s period (qa/menu.mjs bar 3 lists both with amplitude).
WHAT IS FROZEN on the menu (gated on a hoisted `const onMenu` at the top of animate() :9467, never on !started — started is a since-load latch :5324/:7776): rivals.update (:10290), bubbles.update (:10364), fadeOccluders (:10896, walks every edible), attract mode (:9849 — otherwise the hero wanders off the landmark), the eat loop (already :10367), matchClock (already :9524). KEPT: island.update (:9486 — it re-centres stars/sky on the camera, island.ts:4014-4017), voidling.update (:10246), life.update (:10281), curios.
KEY ART COMPOSITION: 'island above, void below' is KEPT — the plateau and landmark fill the upper window, the creature sits low in the foreground looking up, and the violet ground under the window reads as the deep below the island; 'things falling' is kept only where the world already has it (Maple's waterfall and spray, Skylark's rising balloons on the ascension cue, Powder's lift chairs) — the key art's free-falling houses are NOT reproduced in 3D at v1 (new animated props; cut). The painted key art (#menu::after, splash_hero.webp) moves to the boot cover only (#loadScr z60) so the first thing a returning child sees after the cover drops is the same picture, now moving.
ladder_presentation: Five pips per world under the diorama (band 3), one row, never a 1–30 grid on the menu (Hole.io shows the global count only on the end card, recon.md:230-232): pip 1 EAT, 2 SET, 3 LANDMARK, 4 RIVALS, 5 CLEAR, each drawn with the goal's icon inside (points, three-kind stack, the hero's emoji from COPY.heroCue :1543-1664, a crown, a percent). States and colours as measured: done grey #596793 with a bite notch, cleared (100% devoured on that run) magenta #8f2599 with a glint, current green gradient + white ring and 29% wider (57 vs 44 px), locked #98affd + padlock. The improvement over Hole.io: (a) the GOAL LINE under the pips speaks the current goal in the world's voice — Maple: 'EAT 48,000 OF TOWN' / '40 SNACKS · 8 CARS · 5 HOUSES' / 'EAT THE TOWN HALL' / 'BE THE BIGGEST VOID' / 'EAT EVERYTHING'; Pirate L3 'EAT THE ROYAL MARINER', Skylark L3 names the whale ONLY if qa/pace.mjs proves it reachable, else the tower; (b) the diorama camera nudges toward the level's subject (see hero_diorama); (c) tapping a done/cleared pip replays that level (transient `playing`, cur unmoved) — a grey pip can be upgraded to magenta by a later 100%; (d) tapping a locked pip wobbles it 6 px, the void does a 'scared' blink, and the goal line flashes 'FINISH LEVEL 2 FIRST' for 1.4 s — no sound of failure, no shop nudge. World progress: the WORLD PLATE ('MAPLE FALLS ▸') opens the poster grid #worlds unchanged, where each .wCard gains its own five mini-pips next to .wBest (:6717-6737), and a locked world keeps gateFor's text (:6741-6763). Numbers the owner can read: 5 pips x 6 worlds = 30 pips; a pip is 44 px, the current one 57 px; the row is 72 px tall; the goal line is 18 px cream on #4c3cbe (>= 4.5:1, house bar pickerfit.mjs:69 — the parent's 4.2 is below house and is not used).

level_flow:
MENU (HOME tab, diorama of the built world, current pip green) → tap PLAY (#btnPlay, 1 tap; #worlds never gains .show on this path) → launchWorld() for the built world with goal = voidLevels.cur.goal when cur.world === pickedWorld, else goal 1 of the built world (:6503 minus the picker) → menuEl.style.display='none', body.menu removed (:6185) → withWorldReady → startFresh(soloOn()) → beginMatch (:6081) stamps `playing = {world, goal}` beside bumpMatch (:6139), fills #titlecard .lvl 'LEVEL 3 OF 5', .name world name, .sub the ≤6-word goal line BEFORE `armed = true` (:6144; today's one-time fill at :1674-1677 goes) → the GOAL CARD rolls at GOAL_CARD_AT 0.5 s for GOAL_CARD_LEN 0.6 s (:6029-6030, :9512-9518, untouched) → the world idles ARMED until the first touch, which starts the clock and the music (startMatch :6297-6331; opening.mjs A1 stays 0) → MATCH with the goal chip on the HUD → WIN ON THE SPOT: a `goalMet()` check inside `if (started && !ended && !paused)` beside the buzzer at :9681 sets goal.result='win' and outroT = 2.0 exactly as the buzzer does, so the existing slow-mo/rings/music ceremony (:9480, :10203, :10562) plays and endMatch is reached through :9480 unchanged; the clock reaching 0 first sets goal.result='time' (RIVALS resolves at the buzzer from myRank :5374-5378) → endMatch(result) — one new argument, no more inferring WIN from myRank :5434 or solo newBest :5352 → END CARD over the dimmed world (#end z9, blur 8 px, index.html:708-722): #endHd 'YOU DID IT!' / 'NOT YET!' (never 'FAIL'), then NEW #endPips row inserted between #endHd and #endSub and lit ≤400 ms before celebrateEnd() is called (:5364 solo / :5439 rivals; count-up 900 ms :5290-5322), the coin count-up, #endStats cascade as today (index.html:768-787), a LEVEL BAR text 'Level 14 / 30' with the NEXT REWARD drawn in #endNext: on a world unlock the existing TAKE ME THERE card (:5503-5537) now painted with paintWorldCard(host, opened); otherwise the next world's poster under the .locked filter + padlock (index.html:1416, five posters on disk, skylark CDN-only with CARD_FALLBACK :6672-6688) beside the OPEN SHOP door (:5549-5563) → footer #btnAgain relabelled CONTINUE on a win (resetMatch into the next pip; on the last pip of a world the NEW WORLD reload with voidWorld+voidAutoPlay :5518-5520) or TRY AGAIN on a miss (same level), #btnHome → menu with body.menu (:7696-7702).
HUD PER GOAL (one new #goal chip under #timer, 44 px tall, same element, five contents; #quests is gone; no score element exists today index.html:1884-1891): EAT — '12,400 / 48,000' with a thin fill, latching threshold checked per frame because playerScore can drop on a hunter steal (:2945) — the fill never animates backwards, it holds the high-water mark and the number is honest; SET — three icons counting DOWN '🍎 12 · 🚗 3 · 🏠 2' fed from the eat handler's exact kind rules (:5825-5839, same as questable.mjs:74-90) with the 'big' double-fire deduped per bite (:5826+:5829) and each hitting 0 gets a tick; LANDMARK — the hero's emoji + 'GROW TO EAT THE TOWN HALL' with fill = R / (heroProp.radius / EAT_RATIO) (:6114-6116, :3673), flipping to the existing heroCue banner at cue (:10753-10766), win at the hero poll (:10768-10775) on userData.byPlayer, heroProp excluded from rival bites for this level; RIVALS — '#2 OF 6' from the 5 Hz myRank (:4732-4737) with the crown at #1, resolves at the buzzer; CLEAR — '37% DEVOURED' from devouredPct (:4886, everyone's meals as coded, solo 120 s or family 180 s) with fill, win at 100.
ON A MISS (the clock ran out on a goal level): the outro plays the same slow-mo, endHd 'NOT YET!', endSub the frozen counter ('38 of 40 snacks — so close'), coins for what was eaten count up as usual (nothing is taken away), the pip stays green (current), no re-lock ever, TRY AGAIN is the primary door; after 3 misses on one pip (voidLevels.w[world][goal].n >= 3 without done) the next pip opens as well and the goal line reads '…or try level 4' — the 'never a wall' rule of unlocks.ts:5-26 applied inside a world. Quit via ⌂/LEAVE (:7774) records n += 1 and nothing else.
state_model: NEW KEY `voidLevels` (JSON object, matchdeck/voidStats convention :7805, not the CSV of unlocks.ts:44): { v: 1, cur: { world: WorldId, goal: 1|2|3|4|5 }, w: { [world]: { [goal]: { st: 'locked'|'open'|'done'|'clear', best: number (EAT score | SET seconds-to-finish | LANDMARK seconds | RIVALS rank | CLEAR pct), pct: number (best devouredPct on that run), first: 'YYYY-MM-DD' (first clear, toDateString convention of voidFirstWinDay :5395), n: number (attempts incl. misses/quits) } } } } in src/game/levels.ts (~120 lines beside unlocks.ts). Rules: maple/1 is always at least 'open' (the read()-adds-maple invariant unlocks.ts:50); a missing entry means locked; every read/write try/catch (unlocks.ts:48,54); unknown fields kept (stickers.ts:449); version gate `if ((data.v ?? 0) < LEVELS_VER) migrateLevels(); track('save_migrated', {key:'voidLevels'})` (voidSaveVer precedent :8213-8230). SEQUENCE: sequential WITHIN a world (goal k+1 opens when goal k is done, or when goal k has n >= 3 — fail-forward), and BETWEEN worlds unlocks.ts stays binding: world W+1 goal 1 opens when ANY match on W finishes (completeWorld :89-98, 'never a wall', 'nobody is ever re-locked') — the polish plan's 'strictly sequential' (C bar 1, :155-166) is read as the pip row, stated to the skeptic as a decision. `cur` = the frontier (lowest non-done goal in the lowest world with an open goal), recomputed only in recordLevelResult; a replay sets a transient `playing` at beginMatch (:6081) and never moves cur; a replay that hits 100% upgrades st 'done' → 'clear'. States only ever rise (migrate() precedent unlocks.ts:61-74). MIGRATION on first read: for each w in WORLD_ORDER (unlocks.ts:36): isUnlocked(w) → w/1 ≥ 'open'; voidBest_<w> > 0 (:5449) → w/1 'done' with best = voidBest_w (no-regression reading, regardless of N) and w/2 'open'; the global voidBestPct (:5339) is NOT turned into any 'clear' (it is not per-world); QA seeds that write only voidUnlocked CSV (40+ probes, qa/unlocks.mjs:53) read as every listed world open at goal 1 — that is what keeps gate --profile=push green. WRITE BOUNDARY: one function recordLevelResult({world, goal, result, score, pct, rank, seconds}) called in endMatch immediately after `ended = true; voidPlayed='1'` (:5329-5330) and BEFORE the solo early return (:5364), plus completeWorld(pickedWorld) also called on the solo path (today solo never opens world 2, :5364 vs :5503). READ BOUNDARY: the menu pip row, the goal line, the #worlds card mini-pips (:6704-6737), #endPips and the level bar; the ribbon keeps isUnlocked() (:6784). CROSS-RELOAD: the goal to play travels as `voidPlayGoal` next to voidWorld/voidAutoPlay (consumed at :6840 like voidAutoPlay; ?g= mirrors ?w= :355 for probes). UNTOUCHED: voidUnlocked, voidBest_<w>, voidBestScore, voidMatchN (match 0 baseline, matchdeck.ts:11-18), voidWorld, voidAutoPlay, voidPlayed, voidSolo, voidBestPct. REMOVED: voidQuestDay/State/EncoreIds/EncoreN. identity_guard: The void is a creature and stays one: he is IN the diorama with his face toward the child — blink cadence, breath and pupils are the shipped rig untouched (void3d.ts:2050, :2297-2310, :2340-2347); moods are driven through the rig API (setMood/pinMouth/chomp, void3d.ts:54-75), never the _dbg hooks; a tap on him is a chomp and a smug grin, a press on PLAY makes him hungry, a locked pip makes him do a scared blink — the menu has a character, not a cursor. Nothing on the menu is a disc: the pips carry the goal's icon and a bite notch when done, not an empty ring; the ground is a violet deep under a floating island (the key art's composition), not a top-down hole. The world is fiction, not a template: every goal line is written in the world's voice from COPY (Town Hall, Royal Mariner, Stadium, Bathhouse, Lodge, Whale/tower), the crowd has jobs and keeps working while you watch, the season lights a lantern in the world. Deliberately unlike Hole.io: (a) 3D low-angle creature framing, not a top-down model; (b) no x2 coin spinner, no 'watch to double', no skip-timer currency, no countdown of any kind on the menu (4+, no ads ever, parental gate #gate z70 on spend); (c) a miss reads 'NOT YET' with the counter frozen and coins still paid — a six-year-old is never punished; (d) the skins tab is replaced by a SCRAPBOOK of stickers/trophies/top voids — collecting, not buying; (e) the daily calendar and the season are ours; (f) the end card's next reward is the next WORLD's painted island, a place with a name, not a skin. Guarded by the studio skill's art-direction pass before anything visual goes live and by qa/menu.mjs bars that the UI is still while the world moves.
